entries.en: Didn't you say that implant was just some BD scrolling tech?
entries.ro: N-ai zis că implantul ăla e doar o chestie de dat scroll prin BD-uri?

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="そうよ。でもほら、彼女はいつも安物を選ぶでしょ…" t="Yeah, but, you know, she's always going for the discount option..." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="そうよ。でもほら、彼女はいつも安物を選ぶでしょ…" t="Da, da, dar știi cum e, ea ia mereu ce-i mai ieftin..." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="どこの誰が使ったかもわからない、中古のガラクタを買ったのかも。きっと変なのを掴まされたのよ…" t="She probably bought some second-hand scrap from who-knows-where and caught something nasty..." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: So what? You gonna call the MaxTac on her now?
entries.ro: Și ce, acum chemi MaxTac pe ea?

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="その時になったら、躊躇せずに呼ぶわよ" t="You better believe I'll call 'em if it comes to that." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="その時になったら、躊躇せずに呼ぶわよ" t="Pune pariu că-i chem dacă ajunge până acolo." b="" a=""/>
